Create a document with a nonempty title and literal body text.

        body may be empty. folder is an optional nonempty organizational label;
        omit it to use 'default'. A new label is allowed. Markdown and plain text

        markers. Word limits count whitespace-separated visible text, excluding
        formatting markers and link destinations.

Independent reads, searches, web fetches, and read-only commands should be batched into the same assistant turn — the runtime executes independent calls concurrently, and batching avoids resending the whole conversation on every extra round-trip.

arguments.title: Historical example card — Priya onboarding-trigger briefing
arguments.body:
# Historical example card

**Briefing date:** 2023-04-03  
**Card date:** 2028-01-01

## Audience
Priya, in my 1:1.

## What was confirmed
The second cohort also showed a favorable week-1 retention result: +3.4 points (n=200). Across both cohorts, pooled week-1 retention was +3.1 points treatment vs. control (p=0.04, n=420). This was the second-cohort confirmation for `EXP-2023-02-onboarding-trigger` / `lifecycle_onboarding_trigger_v2`.

## My interpretation
Cautiously optimistic: the repeated result was strong enough to call the test read and begin drafting the ship plan, but not to declare the investigation closed or claim the effect was fully settled. The 100% rollout was planned for April 10; this briefing was not evidence that post-ship performance had been established.

## Evidence still wanted
Finish the data-quality checks on Owen’s pull—sample-ratio mismatch, signup-source mix, and segment/country/device skew—and watch one more post-ship cohort before calling the result settled. Keep the confidence claim bounded to the two-cohort pooled week-1 retention read; do not treat it as post-ship confirmation.
